assertions.description: CSS.supports reports the image-animation property parses ('image-animation: paused') — the uber toolbar's animation control feature (ChromeStatus 5078177326170112, currently listed at Chrome 154 Enabled by default, runtime feature CSSImageAnimation status 'test'). Composition evidence boundary: the uber's toolbar control requests paused/running and reads the computed value back; this row covers exposure only, not the uber's specific image.
assertions.test: (()=> typeof CSS !== 'undefined' && typeof CSS.supports === 'function' && CSS.supports('image-animation: paused'))()

assertions.description: The uber toolbar's exact control contract: setting element.style.imageAnimation = 'paused' computes back 'paused' via getComputedStyle (the toggle the Run/Pause button performs; nothing is claimed when the property is unsupported).
assertions.test: (()=>{ if (typeof CSS === 'undefined' || typeof CSS.supports !== 'function' || !CSS.supports('image-animation: paused')) return false; const el = document.createElement('img'); document.body.appendChild(el); el.style.imageAnimation = 'paused'; const v = getComputedStyle(el).getPropertyValue('image-animation').trim(); el.remove(); return v === 'paused'; })()

assertions.description: window.HTMLCameraElement is a function — the interface described by the current unofficial Media Capture Extensions proposal and implemented behind Chromium's CameraAndMicrophoneElements runtime feature; the uber's camera panel uses this receiver (ChromeStatus 5153829504024576, v152 Enabled by default listing; runtime feature CameraAndMicrophoneElements).

window.HTMLMicrophoneElement is a function — the interface described by the current unofficial Media Capture Extensions proposal and implemented behind the same Chromium runtime feature; the uber's microphone panel uses this receiver (same feature and gate as the camera row; listed separately because the uber presents them as two distinct panels).

The parse-time behavior proposed by open, unmerged WHATWG HTML PR #12339: a declarative shadow root created with shadowrootadoptedstylesheets pointing at the uber's own theme.css route ends up with at least one adopted stylesheet (ChromeStatus 4790543041298432, currently listed at Chrome 153 Enabled by default; runtime feature ShadowRootAdoptedStyleSheet implied by DeclarativeCSSModules).
assertions.test: (async()=>{ const host = document.createElement('div'); host.setHTMLUnsafe(''); document.body.appendChild(host); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const n = host.shadowRoot ? host.shadowRoot.adoptedStyleSheets.length : -1; host.remove(); return n >= 1; })()

assertions.description: The <camera> element accepts only genuine-user-action activation and reports the outcome through track, cancel, or error events; successful activation exposes a video MediaStreamTrack.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: requires the CameraAndMicrophoneElements runtime feature, real user mediation, and camera hardware/permission — none of which may be simulated.

assertions.description: The <microphone> element accepts only genuine-user-action activation and reports the outcome through track, cancel, or error events; successful activation exposes an audio MediaStreamTrack.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: requires the CameraAndMicrophoneElements runtime feature, real user mediation, and microphone hardware/permission — none of which may be simulated.

assertions.description: matchMedia('(display-mode: unframed)').matches is true inside a genuinely unframed installed IWA window (the uber's workspace-mode inspection).
assertions.test: Not run automatically: a true match requires an installed Isolated Web App running in the unframed display mode; a matchMedia parse alone is not feature evidence (authored queries are preserved even for unknown features), and no IWA context may be faked.

assertions.description: The injected moderate_viewport_heuristics parameters (pointer-distance band, anchor threshold, delay) measurably change the browser's actual prefetch decisions.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: proving an effect requires observing real prefetch decisions against pointer movement, scrolling, and network fetches — the proposal is explicitly experimental with no plans to ship as-is.

assertions.description: The uber's href-matched moderate rule causes a real prefetch request, and a later target navigation reports deliveryType 'navigational-prefetch' only if that response is actually consumed.
assertions.test: Not run automatically: request initiation needs browser/network observation under genuine heuristic input, while deliveryType separately evidences consumption. Neither proves any telemetry beacon.
